summary: Service demo/frontend is experiencing high latency due to an invalid backend port configured in revision 6.

root_cause.explanation: In revision 6, the container argument --backend-url was changed from http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9898/echo to http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9899/echo, causing backend HTTP requests to fail with context canceled errors and increasing response latency.

evidence.fact: Template diff for deployment frontend shows revision 6 updated --backend-url from http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9898/echo to http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9899/echo.
Container logs show backend call failed error: Post http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9899/echo: context canceled.
The 95th percentile latency for frontend is ~2.29 seconds.

impact: Requests to demo/frontend suffer high latency (~2.29s p95) and backend connection failures.

next_steps.action: Roll back deployment frontend to revision 5 to revert the backend URL port back to 9898.
